title: Smarter.Poker 2026 Open Quantitative Poker Research & Live Cardroom Benchmark Datasets
description: Open CC-BY 4.0 datasets covering 324+ US live poker venues, rake and time-charge benchmarks, Malmuth-Harville ICM bubble factors, PKO and Mystery Bounty chip equivalents, 169-hand preflop GTO matrices, and poker bankroll risk-of-ruin simulations.
